id.description: Stable POSI journal identifier. Never reused, even if a journal is later removed from the Core Collection.

status.description: discovered = found, not reviewed. indexed = passed POSI Core Collection (PCC) admission review. metric_eligible = indexed AND has enough continuous coverage/citation history to receive PCI/rankings.

license.description: SPDX-style license identifier for the journal's own content, e.g. CC-BY-4.0.

psc_confidence.description: PSC-CROSSWALK-0.2 (see CHANGELOG.md). Only 'high' or 'verified' may be used to build an E-Q/M-Q/Citation-Q peer cohort (posi-engine's src/cohort.mjs) — 'medium'/'low'/'unclassified' may still be displayed as a suggested category. 'verified' is assigned only by a human POSI Subject Editor sign-off, never computed by src/psc-classify.mjs itself. Nullable/omittable for records classified before PSC-CROSSWALK-0.2 shipped.

lifecycle.description: POSI Journal Evaluation & Ranking Framework 1.0's lifecycle section (posi-engine's src/lifecycle.mjs, src/first-publication-date.mjs). Additive/optional — a journal record with no `lifecycle` block has simply not been run through this pipeline stage yet, not an error.

months_since_launch.description: Diagnostic/display only — see src/lifecycle.mjs's module header for why this must never be used to decide lifecycle_stage itself.

status_model.description: The framework's coverage-state model — six independent fields, deliberately NOT a replacement for the existing top-level `status` field (discovered/indexed/metric_eligible), which stays as-is to avoid breaking existing consumers. This is an additive, richer model layered alongside it; `status_model.collection_status` and the legacy `status` field are expected to be kept in sync by whichever pipeline stage writes both, but this schema does not enforce that itself.

selection.description: POSI Core Collection admission decision — see posi-engine's Editorial Selection methodology.

reviewers_conflicted.description: true if the journal's publisher has a relationship with Panorama Scholarly Group — triggers the independent-reviewer requirement.

provenance.description: One entry per upstream source that contributed to this record — a journal is typically assembled from several (e.g. title/publisher from Crossref, OA status from DOAJ, ROR affiliation from ROR). Order is not significant; field-level provenance is out of scope for v1.0 (see field_provenance below for the planned extension).

license.description: License of the upstream record itself, not POSI's derived data.

field_provenance.description: Planned extension, not required in v1.0: maps a field name to the source(s) it was taken from, e.g. {"title": ["crossref"], "open_access": ["doaj"]}. Omit until field-level tracking is implemented.
